verifications.notes: The Edit action accepts a Customer object and directly marks it as Modified and saves it without any ownership or role check. No compensating control is visible in the provided code.
EditName accepts a Customer with only Id and Name bound, then calls SaveChanges without verifying that the Id belongs to the current user. No ownership check is present in the code.
Refresh loads a Customer by id from the request, updates it via TryUpdateModel, and saves it without any ownership validation. No compensating control is visible.
GetFile retrieves a file path based on a query string parameter and transmits it without checking that the requesting user owns the file. No ownership or role check is present.
ProfileServlet populates an Account object directly from request parameters and does not verify that the account belongs to the authenticated user. No ownership check is visible.
